payload.text: The Fictional Crown addresses the sources and burden directly. E-001 records Mira's account that Fictional Rowan handed a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. E-002 records Tavi's account that Fictional Ellis was at the desk and Fictional Rowan left with the token in hand, with no handover seen. Both are attributed and disputed under the limited-use instruction. The fictional condition must be established beyond a reasonable doubt. On the supplied record, the competing accounts leave the Fictional Crown short of that standard.

Fictional Ellis agrees the Crown falls short. E-001 records Mira's account that Fictional Rowan handed a blue token to Fictional Ellis. E-002 records Tavi's account of no handover seen, with Fictional Rowan leaving with the token still in hand. Under the limited-use rule, both accounts remain attributed and disputed. The Fictional Crown must prove the receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt. On the supplied record, that standard is not met. We ask for not_guilty.
